speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your appointment. I understand you are experiencing unusual behavior and beliefs regarding telepathic communication with animals; please describe exactly what these experiences feel like and how often they occur. To help me understand the severity, have you noticed any other changes in your sleep, appetite, or mood recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Disorder, Somatic Type (or Somatic Symptom Disorder with delusional beliefs regarding health and lost abilities).

The patient describes a loss of telepathic ability affecting his "failing health," attributed to weather and worsened by ineffective herbal remedies over eight months. Have you experienced any hallucinations, such as hearing voices or seeing animals speak, alongside these beliefs?
